note: GFP recreation area just below Gavins Point Dam beside Lake Yankton, 4 mi W of Yankton off SD 52, between Chief White Crane and Lewis and Clark recreation areas. The oldest campground in the area (1959): back-in sites in a loop under mature shade trees, plus two camping cabins; large day-use area with shelters, disc golf and trails. Between Oct. 1 and April 30 the showers, flush toilets and water may be shut off; vault toilets stay open. --Claude
